binary_kind: frozen measured incremental build, deployed to production on 2026-10-16
gpu_runtime_validation: Same-batch A/B/A on the isolated experiment cards (32K and 250K, baseline and candidate arms on the same card, output tokens bit-identical), then deployment to both production instances and an online verification request on each; packaging additionally re-verified the running production engine with a short-prompt decode request and two long-prompt prefill requests. See benchmarks.json for every sample.
runtime_origin: Unchanged audited Python frontend, conversion tools and auxiliary data inherited from strata/xxs-20261016; only bin/strata differs
source_note: The incremental source changes are not distributed with this package. Do not treat this manifest as proof that the binary can be rebuilt from the published material.
features: GEMM_Y_F16 (qkv, qf, sg, su, sd, z)

considered_and_rejected: STRATA_TOPK_H16_T (topk kernel thread-count scaling): measured +11.96% end-to-end at 250K and +86% in qsa select against a non-regmax baseline, +13.7% against the regmax-only baseline. The key is deliberately left unset and the source keeps the scaled instantiation as a default-off fallback.
